# Metro
> UK news publisher covering breaking news, sport, entertainment, lifestyle, and opinion for a mass audience.

Metro.co.uk is the digital edition of Metro, publishing fast-moving UK and world news alongside football coverage, TV and celebrity reporting, lifestyle features, puzzles, and explainers.

## News
- [News](https://metro.co.uk/news/): Main news hub for UK, world, politics, crime, and breaking stories.
- [UK News](https://metro.co.uk/news/uk/): Coverage of national UK stories, public services, crime, and major incidents.
- [World News](https://metro.co.uk/news/world/): International news reporting on global politics, conflict, and major events.
- [Politics](https://metro.co.uk/news/politics/): UK political news, Westminster developments, policy, and party coverage.
- [London](https://metro.co.uk/news/london/): News focused on London transport, crime, housing, and local developments.
- [Weather](https://metro.co.uk/tag/weather/): Weather-related news, forecasts, warnings, and disruption coverage.
- [Weird](https://metro.co.uk/news/weird/): Offbeat and unusual news stories from the UK and abroad.

## Sport
- [Sport](https://metro.co.uk/sport/): Main sport hub covering football, tennis, boxing, racing, and more.
- [Football](https://metro.co.uk/sport/football/): Football news, match reaction, transfer stories, and pundit analysis.
- [Premier League](https://metro.co.uk/tag/premier-league/): Latest Premier League news, fixtures, transfers, and club updates.
- [Champions League](https://metro.co.uk/tag/champions-league/): Coverage of Champions League matches, draws, and team news.
- [Tennis](https://metro.co.uk/sport/tennis/): Tennis reporting on Grand Slams, rankings, and player interviews.
- [Boxing](https://metro.co.uk/sport/boxing/): Boxing news, fight announcements, results, and commentary.
- [Racing](https://metro.co.uk/sport/horse-racing/): Horse racing coverage including festivals, tips, and race-day news.

## Entertainment
- [Entertainment](https://metro.co.uk/entertainment/): Main entertainment section for TV, film, music, and celebrity news.
- [TV](https://metro.co.uk/tv/): Television news, soap coverage, interviews, and streaming recommendations.
- [Film](https://metro.co.uk/entertainment/film/): Film news, reviews, trailers, and cinema release coverage.
- [Celebrity](https://metro.co.uk/entertainment/celebrity/): Celebrity news, interviews, red carpet coverage, and social media moments.
- [Music](https://metro.co.uk/entertainment/music/): Music news, artist interviews, releases, and live performance coverage.
- [Soaps](https://metro.co.uk/tag/soaps/): Soap opera updates, spoilers, cast news, and episode previews.
- [Streaming](https://metro.co.uk/tag/streaming/): News and recommendations for Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video, and other platforms.

## Lifestyle
- [Lifestyle](https://metro.co.uk/lifestyle/): Lifestyle hub covering health, food, relationships, and everyday living.
- [Travel](https://metro.co.uk/lifestyle/travel/): Travel features, destination guides, deals, and holiday advice.
- [Food](https://metro.co.uk/lifestyle/food/): Recipes, restaurant news, supermarket updates, and food trends.
- [Health](https://metro.co.uk/lifestyle/health/): Health reporting, wellbeing advice, and medical explainers.
- [Property](https://metro.co.uk/lifestyle/property/): Housing market news, renting, buying, and home design features.
- [Sex](https://metro.co.uk/lifestyle/sex/): Relationships and sex advice, features, and personal stories.
- [Shopping](https://metro.co.uk/tag/shopping/): Product recommendations, retail news, and consumer-focused buying guides.

## Opinion and Features
- [Platform](https://metro.co.uk/platform/): Opinion and first-person essays from Metro contributors and guest writers.
- [Voices](https://metro.co.uk/tag/voices/): Comment pieces and perspectives on current affairs and culture.
- [Features](https://metro.co.uk/tag/features/): Longer-form features, interviews, and in-depth human-interest stories.
- [Explainers](https://metro.co.uk/tag/explainer/): Articles answering common questions behind major news and trends.
- [What I Rent](https://metro.co.uk/tag/what-i-rent/): Recurring feature exploring rental homes, costs, and tenant experiences.
- [What I Own](https://metro.co.uk/tag/what-i-own/): First-person property feature about buying homes and affordability.

## Puzzles and Games
- [Puzzles](https://metro.co.uk/puzzles/): Hub for Metro’s daily puzzles and brainteasers.
- [Crossword](https://metro.co.uk/puzzles/crossword/): Daily crossword puzzles and archive entries.
- [Quick Crossword](https://metro.co.uk/puzzles/quick-crossword/): Short-form crossword puzzle for daily play.
- [Cryptic Crossword](https://metro.co.uk/puzzles/cryptic-crossword/): Cryptic crossword puzzle for more advanced solvers.
- [Sudoku](https://metro.co.uk/puzzles/sudoku/): Daily Sudoku puzzles with varying difficulty levels.
- [Word Wheel](https://metro.co.uk/puzzles/word-wheel/): Daily word puzzle challenging players to build words from letters.

## Special Interest
- [Tech](https://metro.co.uk/tag/tech/): Consumer technology news, gadgets, apps, and digital culture coverage.
- [Money](https://metro.co.uk/tag/money/): Personal finance, bills, savings, benefits, and consumer cost-of-living stories.
- [Motoring](https://metro.co.uk/tag/motoring/): Car news, driving advice, transport policy, and motoring features.
- [Books](https://metro.co.uk/tag/books/): Book news, author interviews, reviews, and reading recommendations.
- [Parenting](https://metro.co.uk/tag/parenting/): Parenting stories, family life features, and practical advice.
- [Jobs](https://metro.co.uk/tag/jobs/): Employment news, workplace trends, and career-related reporting.

## Metro Information
- [About Metro](https://metro.co.uk/about/): Overview of Metro as a publication and its editorial mission.
- [Contact Us](https://metro.co.uk/contact-us/): Contact information for editorial, commercial, and general enquiries.
- [Editorial Complaints](https://metro.co.uk/editorial-complaints/): Process for raising editorial complaints and corrections issues.
- [Privacy Policy](https://metro.co.uk/privacy-policy/): Information on data collection, cookies, and privacy practices.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://metro.co.uk/terms-and-conditions/): Legal terms governing use of the website and services.
- [Advertise with Metro](https://metro.co.uk/advertising/): Commercial advertising information for brands and agencies.
